projects.title: Interior Ambient Lighting System
projects.description:
Design and drafting a prototype for interior ambient lighting system which could easily install by consumer to personalize car interior. The LEDs light system allows up to 65000 combinations of color (red, green, blue) controlled by an Android application using bluetooth communication. It is capable of various predefined pattern, preset mood (color combination), and zone support (allow different color to be exhibit on different zones)
The project requires a complete hardware, firmware and software design from ground up. With the Arduino Atmega2560 development board as the system's heart and other electronic device (bluetooth module, LIN transceiver chip, LEDs module, ...), the system is mobile, sturdy, and cost effective.

projects.title: Portable In-Vehicle Ambient Lighting System
projects.description:
This project is our group's senior design project. As the title implies, the system we are building allows the user to control the lighting inside of his or her vehicle using their Bluetooth-enabled Android phone. The system is composed of three main components: the Android phone, the system controller box, and the ambient RGB LEDs. 

Powered by the vehicle's battery, the system controller box receives a signal via Bluetooth from the Android device, and processes what the lights must do. Based on this, the system controller box will address the appropriate lights to control its color, brightness, and the lighting patterns if the user should choose one. Because the system is self-contained, the customer may remove the system at any time if they wish to change vehicles.

The system is not restrained to vehicles alone, such that they can be placed around the house or other places without extensive installation requirements.
